versions.changelog: Relicense ClawHub distribution to MIT-0 (ClawHub policy); canonical remains Apache-2.0

agent-verifier 0.2.0 introduces a small, dedicated pre-send verification layer for outbound agents.

- Provides independent review of every outbound message (email, social, helpdesk reply) via deterministic gates (calendar, redlist, regex) and an optional semantic LLM check.
- Generates a structured, per-message audit log suitable for regulator review.
- Supports custom redlists and pluggable LLMs for semantic checks; easily integrated into any Python 3.10+ agent stack.
- Enforces separation of drafting and approval steps to ensure genuine independent control.
- Simple library install; no required dependencies beyond standard Python.
